annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence (Egypt MCIT AI portal page)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence (Egypt MCIT AI portal page)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Egypt
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Egyptian MCIT web page describing the national AI framework: the National Council for AI, the second National AI Strategy (2025–2030), the Charter for Responsible AI, the ECRAI centre with its AI Audit Lab, capacity-building programmes and international cooperation. General AI only, with no robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: NCAI, established 2019, expanded in January 2026 to cover quantum computing and emerging technologies
National AI Strategy 2025–2030 rests on six pillars: governance, data, infrastructure, technology, talent, ecosystem
Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI (2023) sets fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy and human oversight principles
ECRAI enforces the National AI Governance Framework and runs an AI Audit Lab for pre-deployment testing
International cooperation with UNESCO, OECD, ITU, AU and others
